analysis.reasonEn: Maintaining a wait-and-see approach for 3 consecutive trading days. RSI is consolidating around the 50-level, showing a lack of direction. MACD histogram shows improvement but not yet at a level to confirm a trend reversal. The 5-day low of $700.74 is higher than the 20-day low of $689.04, forming a Higher Low pattern, but the volume ratio of 0.42 indicates a lack of momentum, reducing trend reversal confidence. ADX at 10.5 signifies a non-trending phase. Therefore, maintaining a wait-and-see stance.
